verdict.rationale: mParticle documents Client SDKs, a 'send your first event' flow, and a direct event-sending path (likely server-side), with IDSync covering identify-style identity management. Community comments confirm it serves as a mobile SDK collection layer. The evidence is mostly page titles, though: there are no details of SDK platforms, a server SDK, or a documented event spec mapping to track/identify/page. Missing for 10: explicit web, mobile and server SDK coverage, a documented tracking spec with track/identify/page semantics (page/screen calls are unevidenced), and hands-on corroboration.
